thread:
MonitoringBot: Pager: Tenant check failing for tenant=lyrapay service=tenant-heartbeat-check severity=high count=42 -> triggered 1957654321
Alex (oncall): seeing lots of pages for LyraPay heartbeat. getting pages every 30s. starting triage.
Alex (oncall): @Jen can you pick this up? I’m on call but juggling another incident.
Jen (SRE): on it. I’m seeing a sudden spike in missed heartbeats from the health-check farm in us-west-2.
Jen (SRE): check logs: `heartbeat_checker: tenant=lyrapay last_success=2026-02-12T02:01:10Z` repeated across 3 nodes
Mike (eng lead): do we have any deploys in the last 30m?
Nikhil (infra): no infra deploys. scheduled kernel patch yesterday, but that was in eu-west-1, not us-west-2.
Jen (SRE): kube node metrics show CPU hysteresis on node gpux-17 in us-west-2, evicting sidecars (kv cache). suspect localbackpressure causing health-check threads to starve.
Alex (oncall): customer impact? SLA window shows LyraPay has 99.95 target; looks like missed checks map to degraded routing for their dedicated pool. CS pinged?
Zoe (CS): LyraPay reported slow responses ~02:01 UTC on their integration logs. They're seeing retries. I told them we're investigating.
Jen (SRE): mitigation idea: temporarily throttle LyraPay's noisy check alarm and increase per-tenant debounce to 90s, while we remediate. would reduce pages.
Mike (eng lead): agree. prefer targeted tuning over org-wide silence. we need to avoid masking real outages.
Jen (SRE): rolling a change to alerting config: `alerts/tenant_heartbeat_targets.yaml` patch: lyrapay.debounce_seconds: 90; lyrapay.pager_threshold: 5 -> submitting PR
Alex (oncall): paste PR link?
Jen (SRE): PR: https://git.internal/r/alerts/1234 change set -> deploying via ci-alerts.
MonitoringBot: Deploy started for alerts config (ci-alerts) by Jen (SRE) 1957654380
Jen (SRE): deployed. now adjusting PagerDuty schedule routing to reduce duplicate escalation for repeat events -> adding dedupe rule for `lyrapay:heartbeat`
Alex (oncall): confirmed pages stop duplicating. still seeing metric noise but reduced. good.
Nikhil (infra): investigating gpux-17: OOM kill of `heartbeat-proxy` due to kernel reclaim loop. I’m restarting the proxy process on that node and cordoning if it recurs.
Nikhil (infra): restarted proxy, memory usage back to normal, 3 nodes show steady heartbeats now.
Jen (SRE): marking incident as mitigated for page noise. will keep watch for 30m.
Anna (PM): flagging LyraPay SLA risk — suggest follow-up with product to tighten retries on their SDK and confirm acceptable debounce.
Zoe (CS): I’ll message customer: we made a targeted paging adjustment and fixed underlying node pressure; apologies for the noise and the brief impact.
Mike (eng lead): follow-ups: 1) add tenant-level debounce docs in runbook; 2) add dashboard for per-tenant heartbeat scatter to catch early flapping; 3) postmortem if SLA windows were breached.
Jen (SRE): creating ticket: INF-7892 "LyraPay heartbeat noise: debounce + dashboard + node hardening" assigning to SRE/Infra.
Jen (SRE): quick dashboard query I added: `sum by(tenant) (rate(heartbeat_miss[5m]))` + 95th pct heartbeat latency per-tenant. sharing snapshot: https://dashboards.internal/d/lyrapay/heartbeat/1957654405
Alex (oncall): thanks — leaving a note in the oncall log and handing back to primary oncall rotation.
Alex (oncall): handing off to next oncall at 1957654500.
MonitoringBot: Incident mitigated: rules updated and host restarted. Follow-up ticket INF-7892 created.
Jen (SRE): closing live thread — will sync with Mike and Anna tomorrow for post-incident review.
Zoe (CS): I filed a customer message template in the ticket.
Mike (eng lead): add quantification in the post-incident: exact minutes of SLA exposure and number of failed checks -> helps SRE prioritize long-term fix.
Jen (SRE): noted. saving logs + Grafana snapshots to INF-7892.
Alex (oncall): resolved at 1957654510. thanks team :thumbsup:
